title: resolve() picks a version that one requirement rejects
statement:
buildkit.resolve.resolve() returned a yaml version that one of our packages rules out:

    >>> from buildkit.resolve import resolve
    >>> resolve([('cli', 'yaml', '^1.4.0 || ^2.0.0'), ('web', 'yaml', '>=2.0.0')], {'yaml': ['1.4.2', '1.9.0']})
    {'yaml': '1.9.0'}

web needs >=2.0.0, so no available version works for both, and we expected a ResolutionError. Simple ranges seem to resolve correctly. The module docstring says the chosen version must satisfy every range on the package. Please fix resolve() for any mix of ranges.
